signals.thesis: Following Jensen Huang's Thursday resignation and a tiny Friday morning bounce, Nvidia shares slid again to pull broader U.S. stocks lower ahead of the chipmaker's upcoming earnings report and Anthropic's IPO next week. Meanwhile, a battle over Nvidia's leadership has emerged: Huang has discussed a potential comeback with allies as tech executives and major shareholders back his return, whereas Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent called for a dramatic shakeup and urged the appointment of an outside CEO while criticizing Howard Lutnick's Commerce Department over suspected chip diversion to China.
signals.title: Nvidia shares resume slide as shareholders back Jensen Huang comeback while Bessent urges outside CEO

signals.thesis: The United States and key allies signed a new accord aimed at countering China on artificial intelligence and keeping Beijing out of AI supply chains. The agreement comes ahead of diplomatic meetings between U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping this week and amidst heightened Washington scrutiny over suspected AI chip diversion to China.
signals.title: U.S. and allies sign accord to exclude China from AI supply chains ahead of Trump-Xi talks

signals.thesis: Compounding October's weaker-than-expected credit figures and loan contraction, China's October industrial output, retail sales, and investment all missed analyst estimates. The broad-based slowdown underscores fading domestic economic momentum and leaves China increasingly reliant on external demand.
signals.title: China's October industrial output, retail sales, and investment miss estimates as domestic slowdown deepens

signals.thesis: Japan's economy unexpectedly contracted in the third quarter as elevated energy costs weighed on activity. The expiration of household energy subsidies in September left the economy directly exposed to higher energy prices driven by the ongoing Iran war.
signals.title: Japan's economy unexpectedly contracts in Q3 after subsidy expiration exposes households to Iran war energy costs

signals.thesis: After hotter-than-expected October CPI data and hawkish Federal Reserve commentary previously drove the 10-year U.S. Treasury yield back to 5%, the 10-year yield fell on Monday. TD Securities stated that 10-year Treasurys are attractive to buy during phases of weakness.
signals.title: U.S. 10-year Treasury yield pulls back as TD Securities backs buying dips
